cameras.name: overview
cameras.pose_strategy: overhead full intersection including all vehicle bodies, sign and controlling devices

cameras.name: approach
cameras.pose_strategy: ego approach and through-highway sight line

cameras.name: reference_corner
cameras.pose_strategy: near-side corner, crosswalk and stop-line exclusions

cameras.name: driver_reference
cameras.pose_strategy: driver sightline to through traffic and governing device

channels.name: original_ego_body_speed
channels.method: Original body corners, velocity and front station by Native frame.

channels.name: original_through_body
channels.method: Original through-highway body and center station by Native frame.

channels.name: original_view_rays
channels.method: Original raycast from observed ego body to observed through vehicle.

channels.name: original_device_control
channels.method: Original sign and per-frame governing signal or officer readback.

channels.name: camera_frame_map
channels.method: Four synchronized original camera frame identities.

context_inputs.name: site_geometry
context_inputs.method: Surveyed connected routes, through-highway status and intersection polygon.

context_inputs.name: reference_exclusions
context_inputs.method: Surveyed absence of marked stop line and near-side or sidewalk-derived crosswalk.

context_inputs.name: governing_device
context_inputs.method: Observed proper yield sign and absence or presence of actual controlling signal.

limitations: Physical site, motion and camera visibility remain unverified.
Immediate hazard and right of way remain legal judgments.
